summary: Verified the AFM/AADE lookup fixes and settings reorganisation. Response is always JSON (no HTML/404). Unauth call for unknown AFM returns demo with the Greek 'notice'. AADE tab has ONLY the credentials card; Viva panel now sits under Τιμολόγηση (data-testid=viva-status-panel), marketplace templates under Σειρές (15 template-apply-* buttons). SOAP endpoint code updated to https://www1.gsis.gr/wsaade/RgWsPublic2/RgWsPublic2 with SOAP 1.2 + WS-Security. BUT — could NOT observe a real ΑΑΔΕ call for the demo org because the password column in SQLite is EMPTY even though the username is 'boldprod'. So the lookup for ΑΦΜ 094019245 still returned source:demo (matched hardcoded ΟΤΕ Α.Ε.) and the yellow 'δοκιμαστικά δεδομένα' warning still appeared — exactly the scenario the review says must NOT happen 'while credentials exist'. Root cause: saveAadeCredentials wipes the saved password whenever the form is submitted with a blank Password field (see rca).

critical.issue: Password is unconditionally overwritten with the submitted (possibly empty) value. The UI placeholder says «κενό = διατήρηση» so the user expects a blank input to preserve the stored password, but the action calls .set({ aadeRgPassword: parsed.data.aadeRgPassword }) unconditionally. Result: after any re-save (e.g. correcting the username) the password is wiped and every subsequent /api/afm/lookup falls to demo. Reproduced against SQLite: org fa82eab8… → aade_rg_username='boldprod', aade_rg_password='' (empty).

minor.issue: For AFMs present in the hardcoded DEMO_DB (094019245, 094149814, 800000118) the response omits the Greek 'notice' explaining that credentials must be configured — a UI caller cannot tell the reply is demo. Consider adding the same notice to every branch of the demo fallback, or forwarding the source:'demo' + notice pair for known AFMs too. (Not blocking, but the review request lists this case explicitly.)

2) Unauth call for a valid AFM NOT in DEMO_DB (123456783) returns {ok:true, source:'demo', data:{…, notice:'Δοκιμαστικό αποτέλεσμα. Καταχωρίστε διαπιστευτήρια ΑΑΔΕ …'}}.

3) SOAP client rewritten: endpoint = https://www1.gsis.gr/wsaade/RgWsPublic2/RgWsPublic2, Content-Type = application/soap+xml, WS-Security UsernameToken + rgWsPublic2AfmMethod / INPUT_REC (afm_called_by empty, afm_called_for=<AFM>). Fault text is extracted from wsse Text / faultstring and returned as {ok:false, source:'aade', error:'…'}. Only readable in code — cannot exercise end-to-end because the demo org's password is empty (see critical bug).
4) /settings?tab=aade renders ONLY 'Διαπιστευτήρια ΑΑΔΕ (RgWsPublic2)'. Verified card titles list = ['Διαπιστευτήρια ΑΑΔΕ (RgWsPublic2)']. No Viva panel, no marketplace templates on this tab.
5) VivaStatusPanel now lives under /settings?tab=invoicing → data-testid=viva-status-panel count=1.
6) MarketplaceTemplates now lives under /settings?tab=series → [data-testid^=template-apply-] count=15 (buttons still work per existing tests).
7) 'Δοκιμή σύνδεσης' button now returns a specific message. With current DB state (username='boldprod', password='') → toast 'Δεν έχετε αποθηκεύσει διαπιστευτήρια.' No vague 'Επιτυχία' anywhere.

8) Regression: /dashboard, /invoices, /deadlines, /reports/withholding all HTTP 200. Manual customer save works: POST /customers/new saved (redirected to /customers/6c4177c3-…). Login works with demo@timologio.gr / demo1234.
9) 390 px viewport on /settings?tab=aade → scrollWidth == clientWidth (390) → no horizontal overflow.

action_items: (HIGH) Fix saveAadeCredentials: when the submitted password is empty, KEEP the existing aadeRgPassword. Suggested patch — build the update object conditionally: const patch: any = { aadeRgUsername: parsed.data.aadeRgUsername }; if (parsed.data.aadeRgPassword) patch.aadeRgPassword = parsed.data.aadeRgPassword; await db.update(organizations).set(patch)... Then re-seed 'boldprod' with the actual password so end-to-end testing can hit RgWsPublic2 and the yellow demo-warning stops showing.

(MEDIUM) After the above fix, either (a) restore the user's password (they know it) or (b) confirm with the user that they want to re-enter it in /settings?tab=aade. In this iteration the tester deliberately did NOT touch the credentials per instructions.
(LOW) Add the 'notice' field to the hardcoded DEMO_DB branch of /api/afm/lookup so callers can always distinguish demo from real data programmatically (not just via j.source).
critical_code_review_comments: aade-settings.ts::saveAadeCredentials unconditionally overwrites aadeRgPassword even when the input is empty — contradicts the UI hint «κενό = διατήρηση». See action item.

afm/lookup/route.ts::tryRealLookup — the SOAP fault is looked up via pick('Text') or pick('faultstring'). SOAP 1.2 wraps the human text in <env:Reason><env:Text xml:lang="…">…</env:Text></env:Reason>; the regex '<(?:\w+:)?Text[^>]*>([^<]*)</(?:\w+:)?Text>' captures the first inner text, which is fine — but 'error_descr' from RgWsPublic2 is inside <ns2:call_information>/<ns2:call_seq_id>… the pick() helper uses [^<]* which cannot cross nested tags, so complex faults may return an empty string. Consider parsing with fast-xml-parser or DOMParser for robustness.

afm/lookup/route.ts — pick('deactivation_flag')==='1' is inverted logic: in the ΑΑΔΕ schema deactivation_flag='1' means DEACTIVATED. So `active: deactivation ? deactivation === '1' : true` marks deactivated companies as active. Should be `deactivation !== '1'`.

afm/lookup/route.ts — orgId is accepted from the request body without any authorisation check. Any caller could pass another org's id and receive the fault/data using that org's credentials (info leak, and worse: could exhaust another org's ΑΑΔΕ quota). The route must ignore the body.orgId OR require the caller's session to belong to that org.

settings/aade-credentials-form.tsx — clicking «Δοκιμή σύνδεσης» calls the server action which itself fetches /api/afm/lookup over HTTP against APP_URL. That works but is a self-loop that carries no session cookie; it succeeds today because the action passes orgId in the body — see previous point, this is the exact input vector that leaks credentials cross-org.

MarketplaceTemplates + VivaStatusPanel — good move, but the settings-page `Promise.all` still fetches emails/webhooks/keys unconditionally. When the user opens the aade or invoicing tab those queries are wasted (SQLite is cheap so non-blocking).

rca of the issue: USER-VISIBLE SYMPTOM: after saving ΑΑΔΕ credentials, /api/afm/lookup keeps returning source:'demo' and the customer form shows the yellow 'δοκιμαστικά δεδομένα' warning. WHY: /app/frontend/src/app/actions/aade-settings.ts::saveAadeCredentials builds an unconditional update `.set({ aadeRgUsername: parsed.data.aadeRgUsername, aadeRgPassword: parsed.data.aadeRgPassword })`. When the user submits the form for a second time (e.g. to correct the username) the Password field is empty and the Zod schema defaults it to '' — so the previously stored password is overwritten with the empty string. WHERE: the runtime SQLite reflects this exactly — SELECT aade_rg_username, aade_rg_password FROM organizations WHERE id='fa82eab8-…' → ('boldprod', ''). The lookup route then does `if (username && password)` which short-circuits on the empty password → returns demo. MITIGATION: only include aadeRgPassword in the SET clause when parsed.data.aadeRgPassword.length > 0. Also add explicit UI copy: 'Αφήστε κενό για διατήρηση' next to the field to reinforce the behaviour. Ideally also mask the stored password with a boolean hasPassword indicator and require re-typing only for changes.
